summary: Correct the wallet citation to 55/8
rationale: 55/8 contains the exact phrase nafəl mine dozdan in the account of the dropped wallet. 55/7 describes two thieves watching the narrator and contains no falling wallet. The automatic found status is misleading.

summary: Correct the sympathy citation to 63/234
rationale: 63/234 has the same question Qay konəflutu qumi? and the matching translation. 63/287 concerns a fox eating the bones of the dead and contains no such question.

summary: Translate hawar as an outcry
after: An outcry arose in the city
rationale: The Turoyo has hawar, an audible cry or call for help, and the edition translates großes Wehgeschrei. Panic replaces the cry with an emotional state.

summary: Restore the corpus preposition b- before gawux
rationale: The cited verse reads nofəl hayba b gawux. The entry substitutes d for b; this is a consonant change, not clitic-boundary or vowel normalization.

summary: 74/99 illustrates getting into a predicament.
rationale: The input provides the complete contextual passage; a nonphysical b-situation has a human subject.

summary: LB 58 illustrates falling into captors’ power.
rationale: Full Talay 1/58 context is now supplied; it explicitly makes the speaker subject to what captors wish to do. This resolves batch 1’s withheld reassignment.

data.label: 5b
data.gloss: (vom Los; mit ʕal-) auf j-n oder etw. fallen, j-n oder etw. bestimmen

rationale: The lot is subject and the selected object is ʕal-marked; 5 instead assigns a theme to a beneficiary. The military b-unit use is related.

summary: New sense 1c: (beim Spiel) einen Fehlversuch machen und dadurch den Zug oder die bisherige Rolle verlieren

data.label: 1c
data.gloss: (beim Spiel) einen Fehlversuch machen und dadurch den Zug oder die bisherige Rolle verlieren

rationale: Both games explicitly explain falling as failure under the rules. In leapfrog the player changes role, so complete exclusion from the game is too strong.

summary: New sense 21: (mit taḥt iḏ-, bayn lappat) unter j-s Gewalt, Leitung geraten

data.gloss: (mit taḥt iḏ-, bayn lappat) unter j-s Gewalt, Leitung geraten

rationale: Forty monks come under the abbot’s authority; a personal control relation differs from mere allotment in 5. Batch 2 supplies the full LB 58 parallel: capture and abbatial control share coming under another’s power, with different prepositional phrases.

summary: New sense 3: (mit b-ʕaql) j-m etw. begreiflich machen

summary: New sense 6c: (mit bəṯr-) j-m folgen, nachsetzen
rationale: Soldiers pursue two men; the same personal bəṯr-frame also occurs in an uncertain report about following a man. Pursuit is secure from the first context.

data.gloss: (mit b-) einer Dienststelle oder Einheit zugeteilt werden

rationale: Repeated person-subject placement in Konya, a company, and a hospital. Round-1 5b has the lot as subject, so the argument coding differs.

summary: Botanical seed formation, visible fibres, road appearing, and epidemic emergence extend the existing arise meaning to different subjects; do not create separate senses for those participants.

summary: The physician sets to work on a patient’s body without hostile intent; movement ahead of someone and to assigned positions also retain the core directed-movement meaning.

Rest/relief can enter a person (raḥa + b-experiencer). This is a positive emotional-state extension, not a separate befalling sense. Tarqen on the heart is an emotional impact, not an established audible sound.
b-activity in witchcraft joins the physician’s vigorous work on the body from batch 1. Treat as engagement in a task, not a new activity-specific sense.
qum ruḥ- gives reflexive self-pity in two independent passages, not grooming sense 16. The frame alone does not determine meaning.
Decline into poverty includes a bare faqir predicate as well as unexpressed deteriorating circumstances.

Decline extends to political power, the strength of fermenting raisins, and monetary value.

The onset pattern extends to February, sweetness developing in grapes, and fire ignition.
